critical_code_review_comments: Phase 2 implementation is complete and well-structured
EditorContext properly manages new fields (preset, alignment, deviceVisibility, cta, animation)
LayoutSection component correctly applies PRESET_STYLES, ANIMATION_VARIANTS, DEVICE_CLASS maps
duplicateSection function properly copies settings between sections
Minor: Console hydration warnings in EditorSidebar due to Emergent visual editor wrapper - cosmetic only
context_for_next_testing_agent: CMS Layout System Phase 2 complete. New features added to Phase 1: (1) Style presets - 5 options (default/card/accent/muted/highlight) that apply different backgrounds/borders, (2) Alignment - left/center text alignment, (3) Device visibility - all/desktop/mobile responsive classes, (4) CTA controls - toggle + label + href for section CTAs, (5) Animation - 5 types using framer-motion (none/fade-up/fade-in/slide-left/slide-right), (6) Duplicate section settings - copy settings from one section to another, (7) Templates - save/load/delete reusable layout configurations. All settings persist in MongoDB layout_settings collection.
